Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/misinterpreted the IMDb release info for Saajan Bina Suhagan. Despite the IMDb page clearly showing an India release in 1978, the Planner stated a USA 1983 release as if it were the earliest and concluded that Taxi zum Klo (1980) was released first. This reflects a failure to reconcile sources and to prioritize the earliest documented release date, leading directly to an incorrect comparative conclusion.
